name: HHRG
recent: HHRG 近期完成收购 Terengganu 一块土地，公司也出现多项股权变动，包括新任执行主席 Tan Sri Syed Azman 增持股份，以及部分股东不再是大股东。最新季度营收和净利均较去年同期下滑。
notable: 完成收购位于 Terengganu Marang 的一块土地。
Tan Sri Syed Azman 出任执行主席，并增持公司股份。
risks: Ng Kok Ming 及 Aperta Holdings Sdn Bhd 不再是大股东。
首席财务官 Cheng Pek Tong 在闭市期交易凭单。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 MYR 23.30 million，同比下降 23.4%；净利为 MYR 0.643 million，同比下降 62.7%，净利率为 2.8%。

recent_en: HHRG recently completed the acquisition of a land parcel in Terengganu and proposed an employees' share scheme of up to 30%. There were also several shareholding changes, including the new Executive Chairman Tan Sri Syed Azman raising his stake and some shareholders ceasing to be substantial shareholders. Latest quarterly revenue and net profit declined year-on-year.
notable_en: Completed the acquisition of a land parcel in Marang, Terengganu.
Proposed an employees' share scheme of up to 30%.
Tan Sri Syed Azman was appointed Executive Chairman and raised his stake in the company.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation.
Ng Kok Ming and Aperta Holdings Sdn Bhd ceased to be substantial shareholders.
Chief Financial Officer Cheng Pek Tong traded warrants during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 23.30 million, down 23.4% year-on-year; net profit was MYR 0.643 million, down 62.7% year-on-year, with a net margin of 2.8%.
